I removed everything in `index.html` that reads as a placeholder. I can't see the rule's definition or run Verdict here, so I don't know exactly what it matched. Re-score the file to confirm the deploy block is gone.

A search for the usual placeholder patterns (`…`, `...`, `<name>` slots, TODO/TBD/FIXME, lorem, `{{ }}`, "e.g.", "coming soon") now finds nothing. Before, it found 11 matches on 7 lines, and I replaced each with something concrete:

| Where | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "Read the disagreements" step and the Try it terminal | `verdict diff --base run_… --head run_…` | `verdict diff --base $BEFORE --head $AFTER`, with a comment saying these are the ids of any two runs |
| Models table, OpenRouter row | `openrouter:<model>` / "e.g. `typesafe/jev-1.13`" | `openrouter:typesafe/jev-1.13` — "Any OpenRouter model, named after the colon" |
| Models table, OpenAI row | `openai:<model>` / "e.g. `gpt-6-luna`" | `openai:gpt-6-luna` — "Decisions API, any model named after the colon" |
| Models table, systemone row | `systemone:<model>` | `systemone:` + your model's name |
| Text input card | `text:…` | `text:Where is my card?` |
| JSON input card | `json:{…}` | `json:{"amount": 40}` |

The model names in the table come from your README. I made up the two example inputs, "Where is my card?" and `{"amount": 40}`, to suit the banking example; check they show the right syntax. Nothing else on the page changed.

If the check still fails, send me what the `No placeholders left` rule matches and I'll go straight to it.
